name: ArtStation
description: ArtStation is Epic Games' professional artist platform for portfolios, websites, blogs, digital products, prints, learning, jobs, studios, analytics, challenges, messaging, and creative discovery.
agentUseSummary: ArtStation is not available as a direct Relay connection because its current official product and legal surfaces publish no supported public account API, OAuth application program, hosted MCP, endpoint schemas, permission model, quotas, credential lifecycle, or webhooks. The apparent `/api/docs/` URL resolves to the consumer Explore application rather than API documentation. Relay will not infer private endpoints, automate the signed-in site, scrape content, or use Epic/Unreal credentials as ArtStation authority.

providerSetup.blocker: ArtStation's current official product, about, magazine, and legal surfaces publish no public account API or developer program. Its `/api/docs/` URL renders the consumer Explore application rather than reference documentation, and the terms prohibit collecting, aggregating, mining, scraping, exploiting, or otherwise using site content except as expressly permitted.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep ArtStation unavailable. Re-evaluate only if Epic publishes a supported ArtStation API, OAuth application program, hosted remote MCP, or documented partner contract with exact operations, permissions, quotas, credential lifecycle, webhooks, content-use rules, and distribution terms.

evidence.supports: The apparent API documentation path currently resolves to an ArtStation Explore consumer page and exposes no API reference, authentication contract, schema, or developer registration.
ArtStation's official artist product surface covers portfolios, websites, digital goods, prints, learning, jobs, studios, and analytics without publishing a third-party developer integration program.
ArtStation's current official update documents Pro discovery, reactions, message requests, spam controls, and required mature-content fields as product UI features, not developer APIs.

ArtStation's current terms restrict collection, aggregation, mining, scraping, exploitation, access-control circumvention, resale, and unauthorized third-party access, so website automation cannot substitute for a public API.
